WITH per_order AS (
  SELECT ordersmark, AVG(fillcount) AS avg_fill_quantity
  FROM orderexecutions
  WHERE fillcount IS NOT NULL AND fillcount <> 0
  GROUP BY ordersmark
), first_benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_fill_quantity) AS benchmark
  FROM per_order
), first_kept AS (
  SELECT p.ordersmark, p.avg_fill_quantity,
         p.avg_fill_quantity - b.benchmark AS first_excess
  FROM per_order AS p
  CROSS JOIN first_benchmark AS b
  WHERE p.avg_fill_quantity > b.benchmark
), second_benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_fill_quantity) AS benchmark
  FROM first_kept
), final_kept AS (
  SELECT f.avg_fill_quantity, f.first_excess,
         f.avg_fill_quantity - b.benchmark AS second_excess
  FROM first_kept AS f
  CROSS JOIN second_benchmark AS b
  WHERE f.avg_fill_quantity > b.benchmark
)
SELECT AVG(avg_fill_quantity) AS avg_final_fill_quantity,
       AVG(first_excess) AS avg_first_excess,
       AVG(second_excess) AS avg_second_excess
FROM final_kept;

assumptions.assumption: Executions with NULL ordersmark are grouped together as one order, as requested. Zero and missing fillcount values are excluded from each order's average; an order with no remaining quantities is omitted because it has no per-order average.
